children.game_version: Pretend to be galloping ponies around an arena, keeping time with the 1&2, 3&4 beat.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 1&2, 3&4 rhythm seated in a chair, tapping feet comfortably together while moving arms gently.
seniors.standing_version: Stand near a chair for support, performing gentle low bounces on the spot.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo with minimal foot elevation.

social_formats.description: Non-touching partner dance where couples face each other.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Various arm and hand motions are possible, mimicking holding reins or rhythmic pumping.
movement_profile.footwork: Feet kept comfortably together, moving on counts 1&2, 3&4.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples generally face each other without touching; open floor with no line-of-dance; turns and chase positions allowed.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rhythmic bouncing motion corresponding to a horse-riding appearance.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low bouncing off the balls of the feet; no high jumps.
movement_profile.posture: Upright or slightly bent knee stance attempting to look as if riding a horse.

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic bounce keeping feet together to look as if riding a horse on beat 1&2, 3&4.
signature_moves.name: Horse-riding bounce

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid touching partner or sticking strictly to a rigid line-of-dance.

music_profile.sound_description: Mid-tempo early 1960s rock and roll driving an accented 1&2, 3&4 beat rhythm, characterized by expressive vocals and rhythmic calls.
music_profile.vocal_style: Upbeat 1960s R&B/rock and roll vocals with rhythmic calls

basic_steps: Step or hop in place to the rhythmic count of 1&2, 3&4.
Imitate riding a horse using optional hand and arm motions.
Maintain a position facing your partner without physical contact.
Optionally add turns or chase movements around the dance space.
teaching.formation: Non-touching couples facing each other; open space with no line-of-dance.
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to beginners; focuses on rhythm and relaxed horse-riding imagery.
